# Determine columns to keep
columns_to_keep = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']

# Select indicator columns
indicator_cols = df.columns.tolist() - columns_to_keep

# Compute missing values per indicator
missing_data = indicator_data.isnull().sum()

# Calculate missing rate per indicator

# Filter indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30

# Create missingness report
